reference.role: user-confirmed landmark, NOT orchard centre or boundary

soil.policy: Align window to native grid from DescribeCoverage. Only modelled context, never laboratory measurements or current soil moisture. Quantile ordering required; no local coverage guarantee.

dem.source: public Copernicus DSM GLO30 tile N45E037, release2021
dem.policy: DSM includes vegetation/buildings; not surveyed ground. Native crop plus30m UTM bilinear analysis grid, apparent surface slope only; no frost-pocket or drainage forecast inferred.

satellite.policy: Follow pagination, retain every scene and all unavailable dates. Collection1 explicit metadata scale/offset must match raster headers; PB05.09 and ambiguous already-applied offsets rejected. Average complete2x2 ten-metre pixels to native20m grid. Accept only positive reflectance, SCL4/5 with3x3 neighbourhood clear. NDVI/NDMI observations, not crop species, damage, soil-water percentage, causal stress or forecasts. No cloud filling/interpolation.

provenance: Raw WCS/full DSM source bytes SHA, STAC pages SHA, remote COG object ETag/size/LastModified before AND after extraction, declared full checksum explicitly unverified, derived native-band crop SHA. No TLS bypass. Research snapshot, no uptime guarantee.
availability: Acquisition/processing/catalog-created/object-modified/retrieved times separate. Downloading a reprocessed2024 scene today does NOT prove real-time historical availability. No forecasting backtest from these extracts.
models: No fitting, no detector/point/range change, no2025-2026 training labels or selection; no field/operational UI write. Existing source files remain frozen. Product use limited to provenance-labelled context and surface monitoring. No local agronomic accuracy inferred.
